title: ViBES
description: Custom GUI Pack. ViBES. Play with taste.  Play with SHINE.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c30824103af7806a8ba2a4030e9f4be4e1c9507.png)
ViBes is an atmospheric resource pack created with a focus on style, comfort, and visual enjoyment =D. The main idea behind the pack is to create a unique atmosphere through a combination of deep dark tones, warm golden accents, and clean pixel-art design.

Every interface element has been redesigned to look cleaner, more pleasant, and more modern while still preserving the feeling of the classic game. The design makes the interface more comfortable for everyday gameplay, while the carefully chosen colors create a sense of warmth and personality.

ViBes doesn’t try to completely change the game — instead, it makes it look better and feel more enjoyable while keeping the familiar style and adding more aesthetics and atmosphere. This resource pack is made for players who appreciate attention to detail, value good visuals, and want every gaming session to feel a little more special.

Just launch the game — and experience the true ViBes.!

![l](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91339229c81fab5eee78fb59cb804b0ed150939e.png)
If you like it, you can subscribe to [X](https://x.com/BySeVs) and [Tme](https://t.me/Kanava_SeVsa)
